phase2_blockers.title: Running estimate version collision — two v4 files with different content
phase2_blockers.description: running-estimate.json and running-estimate-v4.json both claim version 4. They have different timestamps (18:30Z vs 23:30Z), different assumption sets, different completedWork arrays, different schwerpunkt text, and different delegation log formats. M16 traced the collision: running-estimate-v4.json was created during the reconciliation mission as a more comprehensive update, but running-estimate.json was never deleted or superseded.
phase2_blockers.whyItBlocks: The accepting session needs a SINGLE authoritative running estimate. Two conflicting v4 files will cause the same class of confusion that the dashboard generator experienced (M16 F-3: read the wrong file). The handoff must reference one file.
phase2_blockers.resolution: running-estimate-v4.json is AUTHORITATIVE. Evidence: (1) later timestamp (23:30Z vs 18:30Z), (2) has versionHistory array showing the evolution, (3) does NOT include the incorrectly-verified 3-depth assumption that M16 flagged, (4) has the reconciliation completedWork entries, (5) has more sophisticated assumption set. running-estimate.json is STALE and should be preserved as running-estimate-v3-stale.json for provenance but not referenced by the handoff.
phase2_blockers.resolutionAction: Rename running-estimate.json to running-estimate-v3-stale.json. running-estimate-v4.json becomes the sole authoritative estimate. Update handoff to reference running-estimate-v4.json.
phase2_blockers.delegationPattern: INLINE-SYNTHESIS — I have both files in context and can produce the reconciliation.

phase2_blockers.title: Session decisions not mapped to planning brief schema
phase2_blockers.description: The 8 session decisions use a different JSON schema than the planning brief's 54 decisions. Session decisions have: id (string), decision (text), rationale (text), components (string array), provenance (string array), frameworks (string array), status, decidedBy, relatedBriefDecisions (int array). Planning brief decisions have: id (int), title, rationale, components (string array), artifacts (object array with intent), kpis (object array with metrics), frameworks (object array with status), status, related (object array). M12 XO-1 identified this as a schema mapping problem.
phase2_blockers.whyItBlocks: If the handoff says 'apply these 8 decisions to the planning brief' without a schema mapping, the accepting session must perform the mapping itself — consuming context and introducing potential errors. The consolidation should include the mapping.
phase2_blockers.resolution: Produce a mapping table: for each session decision, list (a) which brief decision it amends (from relatedBriefDecisions), (b) which components are new vs amended, (c) what KPIs/artifacts would need to be generated. This is a REFERENCE artifact for the accepting session, not the actual amendments.
phase2_blockers.resolutionAction: Include the mapping in the executability assessment output. The accepting session uses it as a guide.
phase2_blockers.delegationPattern: INLINE-SYNTHESIS — I have both schemas in context.

phase2_blockers.title: Delegation duty component count ambiguity (AM-3)
phase2_blockers.description: The delegation duty is simultaneously 8 (brief #4), 9 (v0.62.4 handoff), and proposals add 10 (PATTERN-CHECK), 11 (assumptions block), 12 (operational learning), 13 (Nachbesprechung). phase2_blockers.whyItBlocks: The handoff must state a definitive component count and numbering. The accepting session cannot implement delegation duty amendments if the numbering is ambiguous.

whatThisAssessmentTaught.observation: The 6-phase lifecycle WORKS as designed. Pre-Assessment identified 3 blockers. Transition resolved them inline. Post-Verification caught the assumption gap. Communication produced the accepting-session guide.
whatThisAssessmentTaught.improvement: Phase 2 (blocker resolution) should have a time-box. Without a time-box, blockers could consume all remaining context.

whatThisAssessmentTaught.observation: The running estimate version collision was the most dangerous blocker — it would have caused the accepting session to read the stale file with the incorrectly-verified assumption.
whatThisAssessmentTaught.improvement: Running estimate files should have a single canonical name. Version snapshots go in a versions/ subdirectory, not as parallel files in the same directory.

whatThisAssessmentTaught.observation: INLINE-SYNTHESIS was the correct pattern for this consolidation. All 17 AARs, both estimates, and all reconciliation outputs were already in context. Delegating would have wasted tokens on re-reading.
whatThisAssessmentTaught.improvement: Confirm M14's finding: INLINE-SYNTHESIS for context-already-loaded, SUBAGENT for fresh-investigation.

whatThisAssessmentTaught.observation: The delegation-gate mock (Phase 3) was not formally executed because no subagents were launched — this was an inline mission. The mock checklist applies to the ACCEPTING session's delegations, not to this consolidation.
whatThisAssessmentTaught.improvement: The delegation-gate checklist should be included in the handoff as guidance for the accepting session, not verified here.

whatThisAssessmentTaught.observation: 50+ scratch files will be processed by SessionEnd. The 13 AAR JSONs, 3 reconciliation JSONs, session-aar.json, both running estimates, and the handoff-briefing.json will all be classified as non-ephemeral by harvest-session.sh and copied to harvesting/. The 4 HTML dashboards, 4 Python scripts, and 2 shell scripts will also be copied. The 23 .md files (writeblocked content, investigation notes) will be copied. Total: ~40+ files harvested. This is the largest single harvest ever — the manifest currently has 60 entries total.
whatThisAssessmentTaught.improvement: The accepting session should verify the harvest occurred and the manifest is updated. This is a test of the .json harvest path that M1 noted has never been exercised.

operationalLearningDutyReport.observe: Version collision between two files claiming the same version number. Reconciliation outputs (s2a, s2b, s2c) were produced inline without subagents — this proved the INLINE-SYNTHESIS pattern. 13 missions produced 80+ proposals that consolidated into 10 themes — convergence analysis revealed the .gitignore fix as the universal root cause.
operationalLearningDutyReport.surface: The version collision is a new class of issue: stale file + new file + same version number. Not captured by any existing incident or assumption category. The delegation-gate mock checklist was designed for subagent delegations but this mission used inline synthesis — need to adapt the checklist for different execution patterns.
operationalLearningDutyReport.propose: Running estimate canonical naming: single file, version snapshots in subdirectory. Delegation-gate checklist should distinguish inline vs delegated execution patterns.
operationalLearningDutyReport.connect: Version collision connects to data reconciliation (M14) — the problem IS unreconciled parallel state. The running estimate protocol should prevent two files from having the same version number. INLINE-SYNTHESIS connects to M14's finding that reconciliation with context already loaded should NOT delegate.
